releasePolicy: Only explicitly PUBLIC lore is permitted in this file.

world-after.label: The World After
world-after.subtitle: Survival in a fractured Central Texas-inspired region
world-after.title: The World After
world-after.body: THE LONG AFTER unfolds across an original Central Texas-inspired region shaped by abandoned infrastructure, surviving communities, dangerous routes, and spaces where civilization thins into frontier and wilderness.

details.Overview: The world is fictional rather than a one-to-one recreation of a real city. Familiar climate, terrain, highways, waterways, urban density, and Hill Country character provide the regional language.
details.Survival: The environment is meant to feel used, damaged, and still changing. Routes, settlements, abandoned structures, and dangerous spaces support the player's survival story.
details.Mysteries: Major infection truths, hidden identities, endgame revelations, and protected story answers are intentionally withheld from the public archive.

alamo-falls.label: Alamo Falls
alamo-falls.subtitle: The primary fictional metro
alamo-falls.title: Alamo Falls
alamo-falls.body: Alamo Falls is the primary fictional metro anchoring the region: an urban center surrounded by highways, waterways, outer districts, service corridors, green spaces, and the broken connections of the post-collapse world.

details.Overview: Alamo Falls gives the game a recognizable regional scale without reproducing Austin or another real city one-to-one.
details.Districts: Urban core, outer districts, infrastructure corridors, waterways, parks, and surrounding development can expand as separate locations as they are approved.
details.Public Record: Only locations and history cleared for player-facing release belong in this archive.

haven-ridge.label: Haven Ridge
haven-ridge.subtitle: Containment-settlement and Micro integration area
haven-ridge.title: Haven Ridge
haven-ridge.body: Haven Ridge is a settlement organized around a containment-facility area and the service spaces that grew around it. Its roads, wards, yards, approaches, and overlooks form one of the region's important survival spaces.

details.Overview: Haven Ridge includes spaces such as Ridge Gate, Service Yard, Haven Commons, Medical Ward, Containment Wing, South Approach, Old Calder Road, and Ridge Overlook.
details.Identity: The settlement name does not establish ownership by a faction unless Story & Lore later approves and publicly releases that relationship.
details.Disclosure: Deeper history remains withheld until its narrative release is approved.

opening.label: The Opening
opening.subtitle: Story and tutorial move together
opening.title: The Opening
opening.body: The Micro begins inside a damaged former family apartment. Control arrives almost immediately, and the player learns movement, survival needs, interaction, traversal, and escape pressure through events that belong to the story instead of a separate training room.

details.Direction: The story is the tutorial: obstacles should exist because they make sense in the character's situation, then teach the mechanic naturally.
details.Interaction: World interaction is built around seeing and focusing on an object, using a fast primary action, and exposing additional contextual actions when needed.
details.Pressure: Early lessons are introduced calmly where possible and then tested under pressure as the escape intensifies. Exact story triggers and protected character revelations remain sealed.

sealed.label: Sealed Archives
sealed.subtitle: Protected story records
sealed.title: Sealed Archives
sealed.body: Some records are deliberately withheld. They contain story answers, identities, infection truths, and late-game revelations that are meant to be discovered in THE LONG AFTER—not read on its website.

details.Notice: This public entry contains no hidden lore payload. The protected material itself is never shipped to the public website repository.
details.Policy: Public lore is curated separately from internal narrative records. Missing release approval means the material stays sealed.
details.Archive: When a protected fact is intentionally revealed to players, Story & Lore can promote a spoiler-safe version into the public archive.
